title: lm-puf: Machine-learning modeling attacks against liquid-metal physical unclonable functions (LM-PUF)
description:
Code for evaluating the robustness of liquid-metal physical unclonable functions (LM-PUFs) against machine-learning modeling attacks. Each instance maps five temperature features to a 1024-bit response; an attack counts as successful when the predicted response falls within 33.2% Hamming distance of the true response. Classical (logistic regression), deep (5/7/9-layer MLP, 1-D CNN, Transformer) and generative (conditional GAN) attackers are trained and swept over decoy-key and featureless-key ratios to quantify digital-cloning resistance.

This is the software archive accompanying the paper "Liquid-Metal Physical Unclonable Functions Resistant to Both Physical and Digital Cloning".
